The `blindference-agent` CLI provides commands for inference, balance checks, credit purchases, and running a local REST server.

## infer

Submit a confidential inference job.

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent infer --prompt "Your prompt here" [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--prompt <string>` | The prompt to send (**required**) | — |
| `--model <id>` | Model ID to use | `groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile` |
| `--currency <BLIND\|cUSDC>` | Payment currency | `BLIND` |
| `--insurance` | Enable insurance for this job | `false` |
| `--payment-service <url>` | Payment Service URL | `https://payment.blindference.xyz` |
| `--icl <url>` | ICL URL | `https://icl.blindference.xyz` |
| `--rpc-url <url>` | Arbitrum Sepolia RPC URL | from `BLF_RPC_URL` env |
| `--ipfs-gateway <url>` | IPFS download gateway | `https://ipfs.io/ipfs` |

### Example

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent infer \
  --prompt "Explain quantum computing in simple terms" \
  --model groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile \
  --currency BLIND
```

**Expected output:**
```
Initializing CoFHE...
Encrypting prompt...
Submitting to Payment Service...
Job submitted: abc-123
Polling for completion (this may take 1-3 minutes)...
Job COMPLETED

Result:
Quantum computing uses quantum bits (qubits) that can exist in multiple states simultaneously...
```

## balance

Check your credit balances.

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent balance [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--payment-service <url>` | Payment Service URL | `https://payment.blindference.xyz` |

### Example Output

```
BLIND Balance: 1000.0000
cUSDC Balance: 50.0000
Credit Packages: starter (10 calls), pro (100 calls)
```

## buy-package

Purchase a credit package.

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent buy-package --id <package-id> [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--id <package>` | Package ID (**required**) | — |
| `--payment-service <url>` | Payment Service URL | `https://payment.blindference.xyz` |
| `--rpc-url <url>` | Arbitrum Sepolia RPC URL | from `BLF_RPC_URL` env |

### Available Packages

| ID | Calls | Price |
|----|-------|-------|
| `starter` | 10 | ~5 BLIND |
| `pro` | 100 | ~40 BLIND |
| `enterprise` | 1000 | ~300 BLIND |

### Example

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent buy-package --id starter
```

## start

Start the local REST server for language-agnostic integration.

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent start [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--port <number>` | Server port | `3000` |
| `--payment-service <url>` | Payment Service URL | `https://payment.blindference.xyz` |
| `--icl <url>` | ICL URL | `https://icl.blindference.xyz` |
| `--rpc-url <url>` | Arbitrum Sepolia RPC URL | from `BLF_RPC_URL` env |
| `--ipfs-gateway <url>` | IPFS download gateway | `https://ipfs.io/ipfs` |

### Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/health` | Server health check |
| `GET` | `/balance` | Get credit balance |
| `POST` | `/infer` | Submit inference job |

### Example

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent start --port 3000
```

Then call from any language:

```bash Terminal
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/infer \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "What is 2+2?"}'
```

## Environment Variables

All CLI commands read from environment variables prefixed with `BLF_`:

```bash Terminal
export BLF_PRIVATE_KEY=0xYOUR_KEY
export BLF_PAYMENT_URL=https://payment.blindference.xyz
export BLF_ICL_URL=https://icl.blindference.xyz
export BLF_RPC_URL=https://arb-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY
```

Or create a `.env` file in your working directory.

## Global Flags

These flags work with any command:

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--version` | Show version number |
| `--help` | Show help for a command |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON instead of formatted text |
| `--debug` | Enable debug logging |
